releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Whitelist Names: build fixes, working nametags, nickname support in commands by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/1
* Working nametags, nicknames in commands, repo cleanup, real-server CI by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/2
* Add op-only /eyerecipe to disable the Eye of Ender recipe by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/3
* Fix nametags not following players and showing to their owner by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/4
* Remove nametags when players log off; cleanup by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/5
* Show nicknames as players' real names; add /namecheck and /nicks by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/6
* Send Xaero's fair-play code to players on join by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/7
* Version 1.0.1: toggle for the minimap fair-play message by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/8
* CI: publish a versioned release when mod_version changes by @Notmoodo9 in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/9

## New Contributors
* @Notmoodo9 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Notmoodo9/whitelistnames/commits/v1.0.1
